note: WHAT A PLACED AI CARRIES AND WEARS (PLAN.md 2.2 / 1j). One table for every AI that a level designer puts in the world rather than the dispatch sending it: an Encounter's members and the guards standing at a building's MARK_spawn markers (game.encounter.SiteGuards). A LOADOUT is `side` (whose body rows and faction: police / a gang id; "" = the caller's faction), `outfit` (character/outfits.json; "" = the side's own body row), `weapons` (catalog id -> weight: ONE is picked per body, by the body's id so a peer and a replay agree) and `extra` (always given, e.g. a baton beside the gun). `teams` maps a marker's `team` prop to its default loadout; a marker or an Encounter may name a loadout itself. A team that is not listed is not a guard (civilian, staff, doctor ... are someone else's).
site_guards_note: Guards at a building's MARK_spawn markers whose team is in `teams` (SiteGuards). Spawned like a shop clerk: within `near` of a player, taken away past `far` of every player while calm; a building whose guards fought or died stays empty until every player has gone past `far`. Only in a building variant someone can walk into (_Shop / _Open scenes). `per_building` caps one building (the military base carries 26 spawn markers), `cap` the island. Guards are the place's own staff: they are NOT drawn from the forces' station pools (forces.json).
encounter_note: Defaults for an Encounter node's exports that are left at 0 / empty (its own inspector values win). `cap` bounds the live members of ALL encounters together.
